definitions.explanation: A traditional candy drawn out into a long rod with a face worked through its whole length, so that every slice shows the same picture of the folk hero {金太郎|きんたろう}.
Used figuratively of people, products, or plans that are interchangeable because they were all turned out to one pattern. Usually critical.

examples.japanese: {金太郎飴|きんたろうあめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{金太郎飴|きんたろうあめ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: No matter where you cut Kintaro candy, the same face appears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}ながら→昔ながら：26817_mukashinagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|つく}り{方|かた}→作り方：27938_tsukurikata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{金太郎飴|きんたろうあめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{下町|したまち}→下町：04193_shitamachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: A shop that still makes Kintaro candy the old-fashioned way remains in the old downtown.

examples.japanese: ⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{金太郎飴|きんたろうあめ}だ。
examples.english: Every one of these proposals is cut from the same mold.

examples.japanese: {金太郎飴|きんたろうあめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で、{面白|おもしろ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The answers are all cookie-cutter and there is nothing interesting in them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けさせる→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{金太郎飴|きんたろうあめ}{式|しき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧しか⟦{育|そだ}たない→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: If all you do is put them through the same training, you will only produce cookie-cutter employees.

notes:
The candy is made by building a picture out of coloured sugar in a thick cylinder and then stretching it thin, so the design survives at every point along the rod.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金太郎飴|きんたろうあめ}{式|しき}: cookie-cutter (style)
- {金太郎飴|きんたろうあめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような: all alike, interchangeable
- ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{金太郎飴|きんたろうあめ}: the same whichever part you look at

USAGE:
Sense 2 is far more common in newspapers and business writing than sense 1, and is nearly always a complaint about a lack of individuality.
